card.name: Endings of surnames like Lindenmayer
card.fires_on: The final piece of a rare surname split into parts, such as -mayer, -meyer, or -eger, right after a name stem like Lindenm, Sandm or Zellw. It appears mostly in news and academic text naming people.

modes.label: Names ending -mayer/-meyer
modes.description: The closing piece of a person's surname after an m-stem, in news or author lists.

modes.label: Other surname endings
modes.description: Final piece of another split surname or eponym, such as -ger, -er, or -eger.
